pb-social.title: Social drafts
pb-social.boundary: Review each draft. LinkedIn is copy-and-open only.
pb-social.changed: The draft or price changed, or the revision is not ready. Open it again.
pb-social.waiting: The revision waits for your approval in Today.
pb-social.failed: The social desk could not load. Try again.
pb-social.empty: Create a social order to start.
pb-social.sourceProblem: The source needs attention. Check the file on this order.
pb-social.noDraft: No draft for this channel yet.
pb-social.trace.bounded-thread-split: Code splits the thread within channel limits.
pb-social.trace.channel-needs-media: This channel needs an image or video.
pb-social.trace.source-image-present: An image is attached to this order.
pb-social.trace.source-footage-missing: A video brief is ready for a human editor.
pb-social.error.OFFER_EXTRA_ROUND: Set your extra-round price, then review its quote before approving.
pb-social.error.SOCIAL_POST_REQUIRED: Choose the exact post to revise.
pb-social.error.SOCIAL_REVISION_SHAPE: The post layout changed. Reopen the draft and choose the post again.
pb-social.error.SOCIAL_VOICE_CHANGED: The client brand or business voice changed. Start again to approve a fresh voice sheet.
pb-social.error.SOCIAL_REPORT_MONTH_REQU: Choose the report month, for example 2026-11.
pb-social.error.SOCIAL_EXPORTS_REQUIRED: Add one original CSV export per platform before writing the report.
